newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's state broadcaster posts greater 95 loss.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's state broadcaster posts greater 95 loss.

text.p: Portugal's state broadcaster RTP, suffering a drop in advertising revenues, posted a loss of 25.58 billion escudos in 1995, compared with a loss of 19.56 billion in 1994, a report by a department of the Finance Ministry said.

A study by the Office for the Analysis of Financing of the State and Public Companies (GAFEEP) said the increased loss was due mainly to a 17.2 percent year-on-year fall in revenues from advertising and increased bank debt, which drove up financial costs by more than 20 percent.

RTP-Radiotelevisao Portuguesa posted an extraordinary loss of 1.3 billion escudos in 1995, compared with an extraordinary profit of 0.4 billion in 1994, due to the establishment of provisions to pay off loans, GAFEEP said.
RTP has lost audience share to private channels, notably SIC, in recent years, officials say.
